name: Empirical

args.name: filename
args.description: File containing the lower triangle of the exchangeability matrix

args.name: a
args.description: Alphabet defining the matrix size and letter order

description: Read a symmetric exchangeability matrix from a text file. For an alphabet with n letters, supply n(n-1)/2 whitespace-separated values from the lower triangle, row by row, omitting the diagonal. Letter order follows the alphabet: `ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV` for `AA`. Any trailing values, including equilibrium frequencies, are ignored. Supply frequencies separately with `+> F`.
